minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version enforced for all connections on this channel. Older versions (SSL 2.0, SSL 3.0, TLS 1.0, TLS 1.1) have known weaknesses and must be disabled.

weak_ciphers_enabled.title: Weak Cipher Suites Enabled
weak_ciphers_enabled.description: Indicates whether any weak or deprecated cipher suites (e.g., RC4, DES, 3DES, NULL, EXPORT, anon) are permitted in the cipher suite list.

minimum_key_length_bits.title: Minimum Key Length (bits)
minimum_key_length_bits.description: The minimum symmetric key length in bits enforced by the selected cipher suites (e.g., AES-128 = 128, AES-256 = 256).

cipher_suite_mac_type.title: Cipher Suite MAC/AEAD Type
cipher_suite_mac_type.description: Indicates whether the negotiated cipher suite uses an AEAD scheme (e.g., GCM, CCM, CHACHA20-POLY1305) or a legacy MAC-based approach (e.g., HMAC-SHA), or none/null.

null_cipher_or_mac_permitted.title: Null Cipher or MAC Permitted
null_cipher_or_mac_permitted.description: Indicates whether the TLS configuration explicitly permits cipher suites with null encryption or null MAC (e.g., TLS_NULL_WITH_NULL_NULL, eNULL, aNULL), which would disable integrity protection.

certificate_validation_enabled.title: Certificate Validation Enabled
certificate_validation_enabled.description: Whether the system validates the peer certificate against a trusted CA chain during TLS handshake, preventing acceptance of self-signed or untrusted certificates.

mutual_tls_mode.title: Mutual TLS Mode
mutual_tls_mode.description: The TLS authentication mode configured: whether only the server presents a certificate (server-only), both parties present certificates (mutual/mTLS), or authentication is disabled.

trusted_ca_store_configured.title: Trusted CA Store Configured
trusted_ca_store_configured.description: Whether a non-empty, explicitly defined CA trust store (bundle or directory) is configured for validating peer certificates, rather than relying on system defaults or no store at all.

ephemeral_key_exchange_enabled.title: Ephemeral Key Exchange Enabled
ephemeral_key_exchange_enabled.description: Indicates whether ephemeral key exchange (e.g., ECDHE or DHE) is configured and active for TLS sessions, ensuring forward secrecy.

configured_cipher_suites.title: Configured TLS Cipher Suites
configured_cipher_suites.description: List of TLS cipher suites explicitly configured for the service. Used to confirm presence of forward-secret suites (e.g., TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384) and absence of non-PFS suites.

non_pfs_cipher_suites_present.title: Non-PFS Cipher Suites Present
non_pfs_cipher_suites_present.description: Indicates whether any cipher suites that do not provide forward secrecy (e.g., RSA key exchange: TLS_RSA_WITH_*) are included in the allowed configuration alongside or instead of PFS suites.

deprecated_versions_explicitly_disabled.title: Deprecated Versions Explicitly Disabled
deprecated_versions_explicitly_disabled.description: Whether SSL 2.0, SSL 3.0, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 are explicitly disabled in configuration rather than relying on defaults.

tls_enforcement_scope.title: TLS Enforcement Scope
tls_enforcement_scope.description: Describes how broadly TLS is applied across the system and whether enforcement covers all listeners/endpoints (internal, external, admin interfaces) or only a subset.

protocol_downgrade_protection_enabled.title: Protocol Downgrade Protection Enabled
protocol_downgrade_protection_enabled.description: Whether mechanisms such as TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV or equivalent are enabled to prevent protocol downgrade attacks.

certificate_monitoring_enabled.title: Certificate Expiry Monitoring Enabled
certificate_monitoring_enabled.description: Whether automated monitoring and alerting for certificate expiry is actively configured and operational, with appropriate lead time before expiry.

auto_renewal_configured.title: Automated Certificate Renewal Configured
auto_renewal_configured.description: Whether certificates are automatically renewed before expiration without requiring manual intervention.

revocation_check_method.title: Certificate Revocation Check Method
revocation_check_method.description: The mechanism used to verify certificate revocation status during TLS handshakes.

tls_handshake_logging_enabled.title: TLS Handshake Logging Enabled
tls_handshake_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether TLS handshake events (connection initiation, protocol version, cipher suite negotiation, certificate details) are being logged by the system or network component.

logged_handshake_fields.title: Logged Handshake Fields
logged_handshake_fields.description: List of TLS handshake metadata fields captured in logs. Expected fields include cipher_suite, tls_version, client_certificate_subject, server_certificate_fingerprint, and session_id.

log_destination.title: Log Destination
log_destination.description: Where TLS handshake logs are shipped for retention and analysis.

all_endpoints_tls_enforced.title: All Application Endpoints Enforce TLS
all_endpoints_tls_enforced.description: Indicates whether every application endpoint and API surface (including internal microservices, webhooks, and management interfaces) enforces TLS for all inbound and outbound connections, with no plaintext fallback permitted.

unencrypted_endpoint_count.title: Count of Unencrypted Communication Endpoints
unencrypted_endpoint_count.description: The number of application endpoints or API routes that are accessible over plaintext (HTTP, unencrypted gRPC, etc.) without mandatory TLS upgrade.
